name: readystack-paper-light
description: Cream paper with ink. A light theme that does not blast you at 9am.

walkthroughs.title: Take this palette everywhere
walkthroughs.description: Your editor matches. Your terminal does not — yet.

steps.title: Turn the theme on
steps.description: Press Ctrl+K Ctrl+T (Cmd+K Cmd+T on macOS) and choose **ReadyStack Paper Light**.

steps.title: Now look at your terminal
steps.description: It is still the old colours. The editor is half the screen you stare at all day.

steps.title: Same palette, everywhere else
steps.description: The identical colour values for iTerm2, Windows Terminal, Alacritty, kitty and Obsidian.
